description: Stage 1 frozen triangle (ROADMAP Stage 1). Camera: CONVENTIONS 4 projection, fovY 60 deg, aspect 1, near 0.1, eye (0,0,2) looking down -Z, up +Y. MVP = P * V, column-major. The apex is 1.5 units farther away than the base, so the vertex w values differ and interpolation must be perspective-correct. Vertex rows: x y z r g b (linear color).
